title: #40 Personal Life
prompt: Many people find that work leaves little time for people's personal life. How widespread do you think it is? How can we solve the problems caused by the shortage of time?

promptSegments.text: Many people find that work leaves little time for people's personal life.
How widespread do you think it is?
How can we solve the problems caused by the shortage of time?

requirements.en: Identify the main problems or causes.
requirements.vi: Xác định các vấn đề hoặc nguyên nhân chính.
Đề xuất các giải pháp thực tế.

requirements.en: Explain why the solutions could work.
requirements.vi: Giải thích vì sao các giải pháp có thể hiệu quả.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The main problem is that long working hours reduce personal time.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The main problem is that long working hours reduce personal time.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Flexible work arrangements are a good solution for this problem.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Flexible work arrangements are a good solution for this problem.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The main problem is that traditional work schedules are too rigid, forcing people to work long hours and affecting their personal time.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The main problem is that traditional work schedules are too rigid, forcing people to work long hours and affecting their personal time.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The best solution is using flexible work arrangements, which gives people control over their time and improves their overall life balance.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The best solution is using flexible work arrangements, which gives people control over their time and improves their overall life balance.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The primary problem is the pervasive culture of overworking, which blurs the boundaries between professional and private life.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The primary problem is the pervasive culture of overworking, which blurs the boundaries between professional and private life.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: One effective solution is implementing flexible work arrangements, which grant autonomy and improve work-life balance.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: One effective solution is implementing flexible work arrangements, which grant autonomy and improve work-life balance.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not list solutions without connecting them to the stated problems.
promptTraps.vi: Không liệt kê giải pháp mà không liên hệ với các vấn đề đã nêu.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.

keyArguments: The issue is widespread due to workplace culture and socioeconomic pressures.
